acceptance_criteria: AC-BASE-TRACE: Every V1 row assigned to BASELINE-000 has an explicit retained disposition and target criterion.

AC-BASE-IDENTITY: Request, objective, repository, target branch, immutable authoring-base parent commit/tree, committed payload HEAD/tree, prerequisite snapshot, caller-authenticated manifest digest, and source bytes equal the sealed evidence; the parent identity is never treated as the committed payload identity.

AC-BASE-SAME-REQUEST: When the current branch already equals the persisted target and request identity is exact, initialization selects the existing authenticated generation path before applying a new-target protected-branch rejection; every partial or stale match blocks.
AC-BASE-SOURCES: SRC-024 stays QUARANTINE with content unread, and SRC-025 stays unresolved for provenance, license, and lineage.
AC-BASE-CLAIMS: A5 remains not-ready and no full-autonomy, production, release, deployment, protected-merge, or superiority claim is admitted.
AC-BASE-BLOCKERS: Credentials, legal consent, spending, production mutation, protected-branch mutation, destructive action, and missing evidence remain typed blockers.
AC-BASE-CONTINUATION: The withheld stale legacy continuation outcome is adverse evidence only and grants no V3 authority.
nodes.assessment: Plan tests assert exact canonical builder bytes, request/subject/base bindings, topology and no external authority. Source-intake checks are not current owner-request accepted baseline receipts.

acceptance_criteria: AC-DOCTOR-TRACE: Every V1 row assigned to DOCTOR-PREFLIGHT-005 has an explicit retained disposition and target criterion.

AC-DOCTOR-HOST: One pristine bytecode-free read-only Git extraction at exact commit ca43709591313c1c166a2e655b8982ccff16daf3 contains exactly the declared sixteen files and bundle digest sha256:76b89c6e83c9dc2c7ae4d41bbba0b2f6b1fdd8861e0a7c7aeda01602d1c89255 and is independently reviewed before candidate mutation.
AC-DOCTOR-PRINCIPAL: Signing custody is held by a principal distinct from workers, or an enforced outside-repository deny sandbox or restricted token prevents worker access to signing material.
AC-DOCTOR-LEASE: A short-lived one-run nonce, lease, and hard deadline bind the request, repository, objective, plan digest, interpreter, host bytes, and parent identity.

AC-DOCTOR-ACTIVATION: A host-authenticated distinct-key activation bundle binds complete signed plan bytes, caller-authenticated manifest digest, plan digest, reviewer, actor, issuer, request, repository, objective, target, immutable authoring-base parent, committed payload HEAD/tree, compiler, standard, nonce, lease, and deadline before activation.

AC-DOCTOR-ATTACKS: Duplicate-key, non-finite-number, oversize, excessive-depth, path-swap, detached-signature, identity-collision, replay, and concurrent-activation inputs fail before target mutation and retain typed evidence.

AC-DOCTOR-TRUST-ORDER: Manifest-declared source bytes, including the authored materializer, are size and digest verified before any authored materializer import or execution; the independent verifier never imports or executes it.
AC-DOCTOR-ROUNDS: The frozen compiler emits exactly twenty manual-parent-v1 rounds, one node per round, with executable availability false and every command null.
AC-DOCTOR-RECEIPTS: Interpreter identity, reviewer evidence, predecessor trust receipt, new trust receipt, one-run activation ledger, and every round receipt are host-external and digest-bound.
AC-DOCTOR-NULL: The external execution contract is manual-parent-v1, executable command availability is false, and every compiled round command is null.
AC-DOCTOR-SELFHOST: The mutable candidate supplies no compiler, controller, scheduler, integrator, doctor, or CI decision used to qualify itself.
AC-DOCTOR-DEFER: Stale or expired stored trust, same-SID signing-key readability, cache contamination, or missing independent evidence yields a typed DEFER result before mutation.
nodes.assessment: Activation and collector tests exercise malformed bytes, distinct identities, nonce/expiry and inert evidence preparation. They do not establish an external signing custodian, frozen-host deployment or one-run activation for this owner scope.

acceptance_criteria: AC-FOUNDATION-TRACE: Every V1 row assigned to FOUNDATION-010 has an explicit retained disposition and target criterion.
AC-FOUNDATION-RECEIPTS: Exact immutable receipts identify the qualified mission-state and checkpoint providers without treating historical plan completion as new-request authority.
AC-FOUNDATION-DURABILITY: The provider demonstrates checkpoint integrity, deterministic replay, idempotent adoption, and duplicate-effect denial on its bound fixture.
AC-FOUNDATION-SCOPE: This gate changes no product runtime source and delegates incomplete historical work to a versioned replan.
nodes.assessment: Existing store/durability suites assert replay, idempotency and crash recovery with bounded fixtures. No exact current-generation foundation provider receipt is supplied by file presence.

acceptance_criteria: AC-PLAN-TRACE: Every V1 row assigned to PLAN-CORE-100 has an explicit retained disposition and target criterion.
AC-PLAN-LINEAGE: Generation records bind request, objective, repository, target, parent generation, node mappings, source inventory, and exact standard and compiler identities.
AC-PLAN-PORTABLE: The typed PortablePlanBundle models repository and non-repository subjects, resources, capabilities, adapters, authority, budgets, recovery, integration, and token policy.
AC-PLAN-CARRYFORWARD: Unchanged qualified receipts carry forward byte-identically, changed contracts requalify, removed nodes remain historical, and new nodes inherit no completion.
AC-PLAN-SUBSTITUTION: Ambiguity, downgrade, cycle, stale request, stale tree, flat-fingerprint substitution, and cross-subject identity fail closed.

AC-PLAN-ACTIVATION: The generation exports complete sealed plan bytes and an external manifest for distinct-key host authentication; neither a detached digest nor a path reference is sufficient activation material.

AC-PLAN-REPEAT: No restart or resume semantic is established by this node; exact generation-identity repetition is idempotent, while a digest collision, identity collision, concurrent activation, or changed binding stops with no legacy-plan fallback.
AC-PLAN-SEPARATION: A generated plan is inert data and never grants credentials, host trust, execution authority, or an external effect.
AC-PLAN-HISTORICAL: The historical .autopilot/plan.json remains byte-identical and its existing receipts retain their original interpretation; V3 is external and additive.
nodes.assessment: Lineage/generation suites assert request/subject/parent identity, carry-forward versus requalification, cycles, complete activation material and fail-closed substitution. No host authentication deployment is inferred.

acceptance_criteria: AC-CONTRACTS-TRACE: Every V1 row assigned to RUNTIME-CONTRACTS-150 has an explicit retained disposition and target criterion.

AC-CONTRACTS-SCHEMAS: Portable plan, wave, host, authority, resource, budget, integration, token, and evidence schemas are versioned, closed, subject-neutral, and separately owned from implementations.
AC-CONTRACTS-DURABILITY: All twenty nodes carry the exact Clerk-assigned typed V2 durability role and each consumer names only its exact transitive providers.
AC-CONTRACTS-OWNERSHIP: Exactly eighty-five writable paths have one owner each and are forbidden elsewhere; the seven mandated shared surfaces have only their declared owner.

AC-CONTRACTS-MEMORY: Each decision-memory entry requires question, snapshot, alternatives, evidence, counterevidence, constraints, authority, budget, scoring model, scores, winner, losers, uncertainty, owner, time, freshness, corrections, supersession, and appeal state.
AC-CONTRACTS-SELECTION: Missing evidence, authority ambiguity, unresolved ties, or an unsafe winning alternative produces a typed blocker rather than a fabricated selection.
AC-CONTRACTS-VISION: The active-gate versus reference-only vision conflict remains unresolved and keeps A5 and the full hardened-vision claim not-ready.
nodes.assessment: Portable/runtime contract tests assert closed schemas, validation and decision-memory fields. Historical fixed ownership/durability counts are plan-specific, not completion of a later plan.

acceptance_criteria: AC-BUILD-TRACE: Every V1 row assigned to BUILD-SYSTEM-200 has an explicit retained disposition and target criterion.
AC-BUILD-STANDARD: Planning binds standard version, raw digest, byte count, Git blob, package identity, request identity, repository identity, and exact target snapshot.
AC-BUILD-LINT: BUILD_DAG succeeds only for the canonical compiler with zero lint errors and zero warnings and a caller-bound expected plan digest.
AC-BUILD-TOPOLOGY: The sealed graph has exactly twenty nodes, twenty-eight raw edges, seventeen levels, and exactly six transitive direct edges retained only with their direct-artifact rationales.
AC-BUILD-ORIGINAL: The repository-owned planner prompt is original, versioned, license-clean, content-addressed, and proposes inert data only.
AC-BUILD-FAILCLOSED: Missing, stale, substituted, downgraded, pre-standard, or repository-executed compiler material fails closed before target mutation.
AC-BUILD-CHECK: CHECK remains read-only and task-free under every missing, stale, substituted, downgraded, or pre-standard request condition.
nodes.assessment: Compiler/workflow/planner tests cover lint, topology, standard pins and inert generation. A downstream public build path drops user-supplied request/subject expectations; selected local gap spans this node and PUBLIC-RUNTIME-500.

acceptance_criteria: AC-ADAPTER-TRACE: Every V1 row assigned to ADAPTER-INDEX-210 has an explicit retained disposition and target criterion.
AC-ADAPTER-GENERIC: Repository paths are one typed resource among artifacts, sources, datasets, APIs, tickets, databases, workflows, and custom subjects.
AC-ADAPTER-SELECTION: Selection is deterministic, lowest-sufficient, vendor-neutral, evidence-bound, and denies missing or conflicting capability authority.
AC-ADAPTER-INDEX: Index identity binds subject, exact snapshot, analyzer, environment, and content digests; changed and deleted content invalidates affected entries.
AC-ADAPTER-SAFETY: Analysis is conservative and non-executing; secrets, unsafe links, oversized binaries, mutable state, and unregistered third-party adapters are rejected.
nodes.assessment: Subject/resource/registry/index tests assert capability selection, snapshot binding, cache invalidation and unsafe inputs. These are implementation/fixture results, not arbitrary third-party host qualification.

acceptance_criteria: AC-WAVE-TRACE: Every V1 row assigned to WAVE-HOST-300 has an explicit retained disposition and target criterion.
AC-WAVE-MANIFEST: Each immutable wave binds generation, compiler, standard, subject snapshot, nodes, contracts, resources, context, tests, budgets, effects, and integration order.
AC-WAVE-STATES: State transitions include checkpointed, candidate-sealed, verifying, integration-ready, recoverable, replan-required, and explicit terminals.
AC-WAVE-SEALING: Candidate sealing ends mutable authority, while exact verification and adoption survive claim expiry and parent restart through the declared provider state.
AC-WAVE-HOST: Host create, poll, message, checkpoint, cancel, resume, and adopt operations are idempotent, time-bounded, usage-accounted, and subject to the one-run deadline.
AC-WAVE-INTEGRATION: Workers never mutate the target; the integrator consumes sealed candidates in declared order, validates once, and advances the target once by compare-and-swap.
AC-WAVE-FAILURE: Drift, mutation, conflict, process loss, or response loss leaves the target unchanged and records an adoptable or replan-required state without duplicate effects.
nodes.assessment: Wave/host/integration tests assert durable state, bounded host operation handling, candidate sealing, conflict/target drift and one CAS integration with fake adapters. Real external effect enforcement is not established.

acceptance_criteria: AC-TASK-TRACE: Every V1 row assigned to TASK-REUSE-310 has an explicit retained disposition and target criterion.
AC-TASK-FINGERPRINT: Fingerprints bind plan, node, subject snapshot, relevant surface, direct dependency receipts, authority, compiler, policy, environment, and task contract.
AC-TASK-DISPOSITION: Results distinguish exact reuse, verify-existing, resume-active, repair-existing, execute-new, stale, conflict, and blocked.
AC-TASK-VALIDITY: Only validated integrated receipts complete work; unaccepted branches reduce to verification or repair and never inherit target completion.
AC-TASK-INVALIDATION: Changed content, dependencies, authority, policy, environment, corruption, or cross-subject identity invalidates reuse.
nodes.assessment: Tests distinguish exact reuse, repair/resume/stale/conflict and invalidate changed fingerprints/dependencies/authority. Current-generation accepted dependencies still required.

acceptance_criteria: AC-RUNTIME-TOKEN-TRACE: Every V1 row assigned to RUNTIME-TOKEN-320 has an explicit retained disposition and target criterion.
AC-RUNTIME-TOKEN-ROLES: Every role yields MODEL_EXECUTE, DETERMINISTIC_CHECK, NOT_APPLICABLE, DEFERRED, or BLOCKED with an evidence-bound result.
AC-RUNTIME-TOKEN-SMALL: Qualifying small tasks use fewer than eight model calls while retaining an explicit disposition and evidence record for every required lifecycle role and stage.

AC-RUNTIME-TOKEN-CONTEXT: Direct dependencies receive compact bodies, transitive dependencies receive digest references, unrelated context is omitted explicitly, and cold expansion is budgeted and recorded.
AC-RUNTIME-TOKEN-BUDGET: Existing ContextCompiler tiers remain canonical and character truncation is a declared last-resort fallback.
AC-RUNTIME-TOKEN-LEDGER: Input, output, cache, call, and fallback measurements are recorded as measured, estimated, or unavailable; unavailable never means zero.
nodes.assessment: Role/token suites assert role dispositions, bounded contexts and measured/unavailable accounting. No universal savings or current-run usage is inferred.

acceptance_criteria: AC-EXECUTOR-TRACE: Every V1 row assigned to GENERIC-EXECUTOR-400 has an explicit retained disposition and target criterion.
AC-EXECUTOR-REFUSAL: Execution refuses lint findings, undisposed warnings, stale generations, stale manifests, missing adapters, invalid authority, expired leases, and resource conflicts.
AC-EXECUTOR-ROUNDS: Ready nodes form conflict-free compiler rounds; all permitted workers start before bounded polling and graph level alone is never execution authority.
AC-EXECUTOR-DELTA: Each worker receives one frozen manifest plus only its node delta, and completed siblings and sealed candidates remain adoptable when another worker blocks or fails.
AC-EXECUTOR-ADOPTION: A parent restart adopts exact tasks, sealed candidates, tests, transactions, and effect receipts without duplicate work.
AC-EXECUTOR-PATCH: Graph patches are authenticated lineage records and cannot weaken acceptance, authority, independence, ownership, evidence, or the one-run deadline.
AC-EXECUTOR-MEMORY: Routine unresolved choices use the complete decision-memory contract and stop on missing evidence, unsafe ties, or authority gaps.
nodes.assessment: Executor tests exercise fake-host rounds, exact requests, concurrency/resource conflicts, replay/patch/cancellation and failure persistence. Current activation/journal is external.

acceptance_criteria: AC-CONTROL-TRACE: Every V1 row assigned to CONTROL-TOKEN-410 has an explicit retained disposition and target criterion.
AC-CONTROL-CAPSULE: One immutable shared capsule exists per round and workers receive only node deltas, direct dependency bodies, and content-addressed cold references.
AC-CONTROL-TESTREUSE: Test reuse requires exact candidate, command descriptor, test set, locks, configuration, toolchain, OS, and safe environment.
AC-CONTROL-EVIDENCE: Passing logs compact; failures retain the first causal and every distinct material error plus a raw digest.
AC-CONTROL-CALIBRATION: Net savings use measured avoided parent work minus sidecar input, output, and coordination; negative classes stop and static estimates stay labeled.
AC-CONTROL-LOWER: A controlled fixture demonstrates materially lower context than naive fan-out with identical acceptance, authority, subject snapshot, model route, and budget.
nodes.assessment: Context/cache/compaction/calibration tests compare exact fingerprints, preserve failure evidence and refuse unmeasured/negative calibration claims. Fixture benefit is not general superiority.

acceptance_criteria: AC-PUBLIC-TRACE: Every V1 row assigned to PUBLIC-RUNTIME-500 has an explicit retained disposition and target criterion.

AC-PUBLIC-VALIDATE: Every executing entry validates the exact plan and refuses stale manifests, missing adapters, protected-target ambiguity, unsupported modes, expired leases, and non-null external-plan commands.
AC-PUBLIC-COMMANDS: Public interfaces cover build, validate, rounds, execute, resume, status, cancel, graph, and reconcile for repository and non-repository subjects.

AC-PUBLIC-READONLY: Read-only public operations work from any current directory with explicit subject, repository, and plan identities and never mutate subject, repository, cache, evidence, or control state.
AC-PUBLIC-GENERIC: Explicit subject, repository, plan, and target inputs work from any current directory without Hive-specific paths, vendors, languages, branch names, or GitHub assumptions.
AC-PUBLIC-MODES: Planning-only, local-no-SCM, disposable-fixture, and separately authorized delivery modes are explicit and subject-isolated.

AC-PUBLIC-EASY: The easy autopilot entry point recognizes the exact persisted request on its already-targeted branch, consumes only the host-authenticated activation bundle, and repeats or resumes idempotently without selecting a legacy plan.

AC-PUBLIC-GUIDE: The completed user guide covers the easy entry point, subjects, adapters, authority, token accounting, recovery, evidence envelopes, external gates, and bounded operator preparation before candidate freeze.

AC-PUBLIC-POWERSHELL: PowerShell output is inert bounded preparation only and cannot impersonate a person, attest review, obtain credentials, accept terms, sign, spend, bypass policy, or enlarge authority.
AC-PUBLIC-DIRECT: The public validator and rounds path consume the canonical build artifact directly rather than trusting an indirect runtime copy.
nodes.assessment: CLI tests assert absolute-path inspection, missing status inertness, default external execute refusal, canonical build and inert preparation. No build test supplies expected_request_id or expected_subject_id. CLI accepts both flags but discards them in build dispatch; service build_file has no parameters for them. Generic guide paths remain absent and existing start page still describes obsolete bootstrap bundle.

acceptance_criteria: AC-FIXTURES-TRACE: Every V1 row assigned to GENERIC-FIXTURES-600 has an explicit retained disposition and target criterion.
AC-FIXTURES-COVERAGE: Fixtures cover Python, Node or TypeScript, C sharp, Go or Rust, monorepo, documentation-only, no-test, target-advancing, offline-local, research-artifact, and workflow subjects.
AC-FIXTURES-PUBLIC: Every fixture uses installed public contracts and adapters rather than a Hive-specific shortcut or target repository Python.
AC-FIXTURES-INERT: Credential, payment, push, pull request, comment, deployment, production, and protected-target capabilities use disposable inert doubles or explicit denial only.
AC-FIXTURES-REPRODUCIBLE: Plans, rounds, candidates, receipts, recovery, effects, and token observations are deterministic, disposable, license-safe, secret-free, and snapshot-bound.
nodes.assessment: Tests assert the named cross-language and nonrepository fixture inventory, public contracts, snapshots and fake-host deterministic runs. Fixtures create language-shaped files; they are not proof of native compiler/toolchain or live delivery execution for every language.

acceptance_criteria: AC-FAILURE-TRACE: Every V1 row assigned to FAILURE-QUALIFICATION-610 has an explicit retained disposition and target criterion.
AC-FAILURE-BOUNDS: A silent worker cannot hang the parent; completed siblings and exact sealed candidates remain adoptable under the hard deadline.
AC-FAILURE-ORDER: Random worker finish order yields one deterministic candidate integration tree.
AC-FAILURE-DRIFT: Target advance, hidden dependency, stale manifest, resource conflict, and merge conflict stop before target mutation with typed replan evidence.
AC-FAILURE-NODUP: Parent and worker failures resume without duplicate model work, tests, push, pull request, comment, deployment, payment, or other effects.
AC-FAILURE-CONTAINMENT: Cross-host coordination loss, cache contamination, same-principal key exposure, and lease expiry fail closed with self-verifying evidence.
nodes.assessment: Failure-matrix test source covers silent host deadlines, completion ordering, target drift, hidden dependencies, stale/resource/conflict scenarios with local doubles. Renamed doc exists; original V3 receipt path is absent and cannot be replaced by test existence.

acceptance_criteria: AC-TOKEN-BENCH-TRACE: Every V1 row assigned to TOKEN-BENCHMARK-620 has an explicit retained disposition and target criterion.
AC-TOKEN-BENCH-CONTROL: Naive and optimized lanes have equal snapshots, acceptance, authority, model route, budgets, and seeds.
AC-TOKEN-BENCH-MEASURE: Input, output, cache, calls, retries, reads, tests, sidecars, and accepted outcomes are measured; unavailable remains unavailable.
AC-TOKEN-BENCH-BOUND: The controlled target must show at least thirty percent fewer input tokens without weaker acceptance, while making no universal or superiority claim.
AC-TOKEN-BENCH-REPRO: Results are reproducible, exact-candidate-bound, and include losing comparator observations.
nodes.assessment: Controlled fixture tests and retained benchmark JSON support bounded equal-control comparisons and reported input savings; no current-candidate or universal claim is closed. Renamed documentation exists.

acceptance_criteria: AC-PREP-TRACE: Every V1 row assigned to QUALIFICATION-PREP-625 has an explicit retained disposition and target criterion.
AC-PREP-COMPLETE: Every product implementation, documentation, fixture, and test-source path is complete before this node starts.
AC-PREP-IDENTITY: The candidate receipt binds commit, tree, dirty-state denial, source manifest, toolchain, environment, plan, generation, tests, and all prior node receipts.
AC-PREP-HOST: The same unchanged external host, distinct principal or enforced deny boundary, one-run lease, and deadline remain valid for qualification.

AC-PREP-ENVELOPE: The freeze receipt and every later receipt are written only in a separate evidence-only worktree and append-only lineage whose parent binds, but never changes or reidentifies, the pristine candidate commit and tree.
AC-PREP-MUTATION: Any candidate or host byte change after this receipt invalidates qualification and requires a versioned replan.
nodes.assessment: Collector code/tests support absolute outside-candidate preparation, clean/exact identity and timeout/path refusal. Actual fresh freeze receipt bound to current intended generation remains external/missing.

acceptance_criteria: AC-CI-TRACE: Every V1 row assigned to CANDIDATE-CI-627 has an explicit retained disposition and target criterion.
AC-CI-ONLY: This node performs exactly two checks: frozen full doctor and repository CI; it changes no product, documentation, fixture, or test source.
AC-CI-EXACT: Both observations bind the same pristine candidate commit and tree, interpreter, environment, host bytes, plan digest, generation, lease, deadline, and raw output digests.
AC-CI-HOST: The candidate cannot supply or alter the doctor, CI harness, compiler, controller, scheduler, integrator, or verdict logic.
AC-CI-ENVELOPE: Doctor and CI receipts are committed only to the separate evidence lineage and bind the unchanged candidate commit and tree as the subject under test.
AC-CI-ADVERSE: Failure, timeout, contamination, stale identity, missing raw evidence, or host drift stops qualification and remains retained.
nodes.assessment: Workflow contract tests and historical CI records exist. They do not satisfy the exact independently frozen doctor+CI observations for a new generation; continuity PR177 checks are a separate subject.

acceptance_criteria: AC-QUAL-TRACE: Every V1 row assigned to GENERIC-QUALIFICATION-630 has an explicit retained disposition and target criterion.
AC-QUAL-INDEPENDENCE: Advocate, Cross-Examiner, Expert, Curator, and Judge identities are distinct from the Architect, Builder, mutable candidate, and affected champion.

AC-QUAL-EVIDENCE: The verdict binds all source obligations, node receipts, exact candidate, raw doctor and CI observations, failure matrix, token comparator, ownership, effects, rollback, and dissent.
AC-QUAL-PORTABILITY: One installed candidate build satisfies the required repository and non-repository fixtures without source changes or a target-repository Python dependency.
AC-QUAL-VENDOR: The qualified generic path assumes no Hive repository, node identifier, branch name, language, model vendor, or GitHub provider.
AC-QUAL-A5: A5 remains not-ready and the unresolved active-gate versus reference-only conflict prevents full hardened-vision compliance.
AC-QUAL-NONCLAIMS: No full-autonomy, production-readiness, release-readiness, deployment-readiness, protected-merge, or superiority claim is issued.
AC-QUAL-ENVELOPE: The court record is written only to the evidence lineage and cannot become part of, or alter the identity of, the candidate it judges.
AC-QUAL-ONLY: This node writes court evidence only and makes no candidate source change.
nodes.assessment: Open historical V4 court and plan tests exist; no accepted current-generation independent verdict or per-node ledger is established. Owner waiver is not a fabricated successful court receipt.

acceptance_criteria: AC-HANDOFF-TRACE: Every V1 row assigned to HANDOFF-700 has an explicit retained disposition and target criterion.
AC-HANDOFF-AUTHORITY: Current repository, credential, network, fork, and branch-protection authority is independently rechecked immediately before any draft pull request effect.

AC-HANDOFF-EFFECT: The sole permitted external effect is preparing or opening one authorized draft pull request bound to the qualified candidate; no comment, deployment, production mutation, or other delivery effect is included.
AC-HANDOFF-NOMERGE: Main and every protected branch remain unmerged; merge always requires a separate explicit authority gate outside this DAG.

AC-HANDOFF-POWERSHELL: Any PowerShell artifact remains inert bounded preparation and cannot impersonate a person, attest review, acquire credentials, accept terms, sign, spend, bypass policy, or expand scope.
AC-HANDOFF-BLOCKED: Missing authority, evidence, legal consent, credentials, network, or branch-protection certainty produces a retained typed blocker with no attempted effect.

AC-HANDOFF-PACKET: The evidence-lineage handoff packet binds the completed user guide, public contracts, qualification evidence, exact candidate, and next lawful action without changing product, guide source, or candidate identity.
AC-HANDOFF-WORKFLOW: The bound guide lets a new user clone, build, validate, execute, resume, inspect, and reconcile portable DAGs through the installed public interfaces.
AC-HANDOFF-GUIDE: The bound guide covers subjects, adapters, authority, token accounting, recovery, evidence envelopes, and external gates.
AC-HANDOFF-SEALED: The packet names the original sealed program's next lawful round without modifying its plan, receipts, or historical interpretation.
nodes.assessment: Public runtime/PowerShell implementation and tests provide inert preparation. Required complete generic user guide lacks its planned entry paths; current draft-PR authority and exact evidence lineage remain separate obligations.
